fusions.name: Patient Lean
fusions.desc: Leans into the target, dealing 12 damage, knocking it 3 tiles back and leaving it 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds. It has a 40% chance to be [Hindered] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Flank Barge
fusions.desc: Barges into the enemies around you, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles. Its damage rises 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles of you (max 32%).

fusions.name: Huddle Up
fusions.desc: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles, and more the faster you cast. You move 15% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Warm Stall
fusions.desc: When anything but fire hurts you, every heal reaching you is worth 30% more for 6 seconds. Once every 12 seconds. Your armour rises by 4%.
